claimCollateralAsBorrower(uint256[]).notice: Function to claim the collateral as borrower. Only the borrower can call this function

claimCollateralAsLender(uint256).notice: Function to claim the collateral as lender, only in case of default. Only lenders can call this function

createAuctionForCollateral(uint256).notice: Function to create an auction for the collateral in case of a default. handleAuctionSell(uint256).notice: Function to handle the auction sell of the collateral. Only the auction contract can call this function

nextDeadline().notice: Function to get the next deadline of the loan

payDebt(uint256[]).notice: Function to pay the debt of the loan
